## Architecture Overview

The `Component` interface is defined in `opentelemetry-collector/component/component.go` with `Start()` and `Shutdown()` methods. It is the base interface embedded by all OTel Collector plugin types: receivers, exporters, processors, connectors, extensions. Currently, Capabilities() exists only on the consumer interfaces, not on Component. Adding it to Component requires every plugin to implement it.

## Detailed Analysis

### Core Definition

- **`component/component.go`** (lines 25-56) — Base Component interface with Start() and Shutdown().

### Component Type Interfaces (All Embed Component)

- **`receiver/receiver.go`** — Receiver interfaces (Traces, Metrics, Logs) embed component.Component.
- **`exporter/exporter.go`** — Exporter interfaces embed component.Component.
- **`processor/processor.go`** — Processor interfaces embed component.Component.
- **`connector/connector.go`** — Connector interfaces embed component.Component.
- **`extension/extension.go`** — Extension interface embeds component.Component.

### Capabilities Infrastructure

- **`consumer/internal/consumer.go`** — Current Capabilities struct with MutatesData and BaseConsumer interface.
- **`consumer/consumer.go`** — Public consumer.Capabilities type.
- **`service/internal/capabilityconsumer/capabilities.go`** — Wrapper implementations overriding capabilities.
- **`service/internal/graph/capabilities.go`** — capabilitiesNode for pipeline capabilities aggregation.

### Key Implementations

- **`processor/batchprocessor/batch_processor.go`** — Example with Capabilities() on consumer level.

### Jaeger v2

- **`jaeger/cmd/jaeger/internal/command.go`** — Embeds OTel Collector with component.BuildInfo and Factories (lines 12-51).
- **`jaeger/cmd/jaeger/internal/extension/jaegerquery/factory.go`** — Extension factory implementing extension.Extension.
